links.statement: For the fixed maximal CM order, type, split level orientations and reduction place, reduction is an ideal-class-equivariant multiplicity-one bijection onto the labelled target component with the induced inert-prime orientation; it gives the same unaveraged finite sum lambda_M(overline(L P_D)).

The fixed CM type reduces equivariantly and with multiplicity one onto its labelled conductor-one orientation component. With the same place and reference point, the unaveraged character sum of P_M equals lambda_M(overline(L P_D)). The opposite inert-prime orientation is supplied separately by Frobenius.

The stabilizer is exactly plus or minus one, so each orbit contributes the integral coefficient c0/2. All 2^(omega(N)+1) orientations have equal contribution by the paired Atkin–Lehner and Frobenius signs. Hence the coefficient is c0*2^omega(N) times one fixed-character phase times lambda_M(overline(L P_D)), at the original precision; the witness valuation is c_theta+c_w.
